edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to take ownership.
transfer debits and credits balances using msg.sender as the source account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] as the spender allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transfer updates the balances mapping for both parties.
transfer credits the recipient using safeAdd.
transfer debits the sender using safeSub.
approve stores the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates balances for from and to.
transferFrom reduces the allowed mapping entry.
transferFrom subtracts balances and allowance using safeSub.
transferFrom credits the recipient using safeAdd.
approveAndCall writes the granted allowance into the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only a parameter of transferOwnership and flows into newOwner, so it is subsumed by the owning function node.
tokens is only a parameter of transfer and carries no independent semantics beyond that function.
from is only a parameter of transferFrom and is subsumed by that function node.
spender is only a parameter of approveAndCall and is subsumed by that function node.
tokenAddress is only a parameter of transferAnyERC20Token and is subsumed by that function node.
